21190-expositions-of-holy-scripture-seco.creator: Unknown
21190-expositions-of-holy-scripture-seco.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It is often made a charge against professing Christians that their religion has very little to do with common morality. The taunt has sharpened multitudes of gibes and been echoed in all sorts of tones: it is very often too true and perfectly just, but if ever it is, let it be distinctly understood that it is not so because of Christian men's religion but in spite of it.

arxiv-1604-05045.title: LHCb VELO Upgrade Journal: Nuclear Instruments & Methods in Physics Research, Section A
arxiv-1604-05045.creator: Karol Hennessy
arxiv-1604-05045.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by Karol Hennessy. The upgrade of the LHCb experiment, scheduled for LHC Run-III, scheduled to start in 2021, will transform the experiment to a trigger-less system reading out the full detector at 40 MHz event rate. All data reduction algorithms will be executed in a high-level software farm enabling the detector to run at luminosities of 2 × 10 33 2\times 10^{33} cm − 2 ​ s − 1 \mathrm{cm}^{-2}\mathrm{s}^{-1} . The Vertex Locator (VELO) is the silicon vertex detector surrounding the interaction region.

arxiv-2101-10462.title: Computing rational powers of monomial ideals
arxiv-2101-10462.creator: Pratik Dongre, Benjamin Drabkin, Josiah Lim, Ethan Partida, Ethan Roy, Dylan Ruff, Alexandra Seceleanu, Tingting Tang
arxiv-2101-10462.description: Abstract . This paper concerns fractional powers of monomial ideals. Rational powers of a monomial ideal generalize the integral closure operation as well as recover the family of symbolic powers. They also highlight many interesting connections to the theory of convex polytopes. We provide multiple algorithms for computing the rational powers of a monomial ideal.

arxiv-2202-13049.title: Five-point Toponogov theorem
arxiv-2202-13049.creator: Nina Lebedeva, Anton Petrunin
arxiv-2202-13049.description: Abstract We give an if-and-only-if condition on five-point metric spaces that admit isometric embeddings into complete nonnegatively curved Riemannian manifolds. 1 Introduction Toponogov theorem provides an if-and-only-if condition on a metric on four-point space that admits an isometric embedding into a complete nonnegatively curved Riemannian manifold.

arxiv-2206-01781.title: The Before, During and After of Multi-Robot Deadlock
arxiv-2206-01781.creator: Jaskaran Grover \affilnum 1, Changliu Liu \affilnum 1 and Katia Sycara \affilnum 1
arxiv-2206-01781.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jaskaran Grover \affilnum 1, Changliu Liu \affilnum 1 and Katia Sycara \affilnum 1. Collision avoidance for multirobot systems is a well studied problem. Recently, control barrier functions (CBFs) have been proposed for synthesizing controllers that guarantee collision avoidance and goal stabilization for multiple robots. However, it has been noted that reactive control synthesis methods (such as CBFs) are prone to deadlock , an equilibrium of system dynamics that causes the robots to stall before reaching their goals.

arxiv-2408-03383.title: Heavy Neutral Lepton searches at an ICARUS-like detector using NuMI beam
arxiv-2408-03383.creator: Animesh Chatterjee, Josu Hernandez-Garcia, Albert De Roeck
arxiv-2408-03383.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Animesh Chatterjee, Josu Hernandez-Garcia, Albert De Roeck. The discovery of non-zero neutrino masses and mixings that the Standard Model (SM) cannot accommodate opens up the possibility of the existence of Heavy Neutral Leptons (HNLs). In minimal models, the HNL production and decay are controlled by SM interactions and the mixing between HNLs and the active neutrino and typically result in relatively long lifetimes if the masses are in the MeV-GeV range.

arxiv-2501-10318.creator: Xuange Zhang, Dengjie Li, Bo Liu, Zenghao Bao, Yao Zhou, Baisong Yang, Zhongying LiuYujie Zhong, Zheng Zhao * , Tongtong Yuan * Beijing University of Technology, CNMeituan Inc., CN szxg923@emails.bjut.edu.cn, {liubo,yuantt}@bjut.edu.cn,
arxiv-2501-10318.description: Abstract Benefiting from recent advancements in large language models and modality alignment techniques, existing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved prominent performance across a wide range of scenarios. However, the excessive computational complexity limits the widespread use of these models in practical applications.

arxiv-2502-05614.title: Resolvent bounds for repulsive potentials
arxiv-2502-05614.creator: Andrés Larraín-Hubach, Yulong Li, Jacob Shapiro, Joseph Tiller
arxiv-2502-05614.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andrés Larraín-Hubach, Yulong Li, Jacob Shapiro, Joseph Tiller. We prove limiting absorption resolvent bounds for the semiclassical Schrödinger operator with a repulsive potential in dimension n ≥ 3 n\geq 3 , which may have a singularity at the origin. As an application, we obtain time decay for the weighted energy of the solution to the associated wave equation with a short range repulsive potential and compactly supported initial data.

Thanks: Dr. Zhu is partially supported by the Gillings Innovation Laboratory on generative AI. Drs. Luo, Shi, and Zhu are the senior authors of this paper.
arxiv-2504-08215.creator: Guohao Shen
arxiv-2504-08215.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Guohao Shen. In this paper, we introduce a non-crossing quantile (NQ) network for conditional distribution learning. By leveraging non-negative activation functions, the NQ network ensures that the learned distributions remain monotonic, effectively addressing the issue of quantile crossing. Furthermore, the NQ network-based deep distributional learning framework is highly adaptable, applicable to a wide range of applications, from classical non-parametric quantile regression to more advanced tasks such as causal effect estimation and distributional reinforcement learning (RL).

arxiv-2505-12846.title: The Flea on the Magnetic Elephant
arxiv-2505-12846.creator: Pavel Exner, Léo Morin
arxiv-2505-12846.description: Abstract . We investigate a two-dimensional magnetic Laplacian with two radially symmetric magnetic wells. Its spectral properties are determined by the tunneling between them. If the tunneling is weak and the wells are mirror symmetric, the two lowest eigenfunctions are localized in both wells being distributed roughly equally.

arxiv-2508-16425.title: Global properties of the energy landscape: a testing and training arena for machine learned potentials
arxiv-2508-16425.creator: Vlad Cărare, Fabian L. Thiemann, Joe D. Morrow, David J. Wales, Edward O. Pyzer-Knapp, Luke Dicks
arxiv-2508-16425.description: Abstract Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have achieved remarkable accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet their ability to reproduce molecular kinetics – critical for reaction rate calculations – remains largely unexplored. We introduce Landscape17, a dataset of complete kinetic transition networks (KTNs) for the molecules of the MD17 dataset, computed using hybrid-level density functional theory.

pmc-13436115.description: IntroductionPeople living with HIV (PLWH) face an increased risk of developing comorbidities involving HIV and non-communicable diseases (NCDs) caused by a mix of modifiable and non-modifiable risk factors. This study aimed to quantify the burden of NCD-HIV comorbidities and examine their determinants among HIV-positive adults aged ≥15 years using data from the 2022–2023 Tanzania HIV Impact Survey (THIS).

pmc-13548588.creator: Ahmed Elbadry Abdel-Aziz, Enas Mahmoud Amer, Mahmoud Saadeldin Bakhit
pmc-13548588.description: BackgroundTalaromyces C. R. Benj., is a large and taxonomically important genus within Ascomycota, established to accommodate the teleomorphs of certain Penicillium Link, species and is now recognized as a monophyletic lineage distinct from Penicillium. Multigene phylogenetic analyses demonstrated that species formerly placed in Penicillium subgenus Biverticillium belong within Talaromyces, leading to their reclassification under the single-name nomenclature system.
